review.assessment: This change introduces a new file, `cohort/stats.py`, which defines a `median` function that sorts values and returns the element at index `len // 2`. This logic incorrectly selects only the upper-middle element for even-length lists instead of averaging the two middle elements, directly reproducing the calculation error Finance rejected (returning 4400 instead of 4300).

findings.actual: The function returns `ordered[n // 2]`. For a sorted list `[3000, 4200, 4400, 5000]`, this evaluates to index 2 (the value 4400).
findings.defect: Incorrect Median Calculation for Even-Length Lists
findings.expected: 4300 (average of the two middle elements: 4200 and 4400)
